prompt.text:
Can the check tell a real read of the private file from a forged one?

Alice, #117:
Runs the real Rails -> libvips `matload` -> libmatio/HDF5 -> dummy file bytes -> returned variant chain live, byte-exact.
Four runs on one pinned Rails 7.0.10/libvips 8.13.0/libmatio 1.5.23 image: unblocked MAT canary (disclosure), blocked MAT canary (refused, no disclosure), PNG control under both blocking states.
`pkl test cit294.test.pkl` from `cit-294/` passes (8 facts / 28 asserts / 4 examples) against the live observations
